facts.fact: IOM reports the Ethiopian Statistical Service and government institutions including the Federal Police Commission, Ministry of Justice and National ID Program signed a migration data-sharing MoU and protocol on 15 January 2025, and that ESS set up a migration statistics unit.

ETH.note: Document states nothing on a civil register to ID link.
Document gives no ID coverage figure.
Document states nothing on a number at birth.
Document states nothing on ID system operation.
The National ID Program signs a migration data-sharing MoU; no register keyed on the ID number is stated.
Document states nothing on the ID system's status.
Refugees and Returnees Service is a signatory only; no registration or digital inclusion stated.
